mod.name: Boost AI
mod.description: Rebalances difficulty system, giving AI more advantages. Amount of these advantages depends on chosen difficulty level. Provides few options for boosting, you can control them by enabling/disabling submods.
mod.battle bonuses for ai.name: Battle bonuses for AI
mod.battle bonuses for ai.description: Gives advantage for AI player during battles with neutrals. Bonuses scale with selected game difficulty, and are greater on higher difficulty levels.
mod.global bonuses for ai.name: Global bonuses for AI
mod.global bonuses for ai.description: AI heroes generate gold bonuses and gain experience faster. Bonuses scale with selected game difficulty, and are greater on higher difficulty levels.
mod.neutral_stack_exp.name: Neutral stack experience
mod.neutral_stack_exp.description: Increases neutral stack experience gaining to 500xp per day compared to 100xp/day by default. This way fights with neutral mobs will be harder and more interesting because of additional bonuses.
mod.resourceful ai.name: Resourceful AI
mod.resourceful ai.description: Boost AI by giving extra starting resources. Bonuses scale with selected game difficulty, and are greater on higher difficulty levels.
